City of Chicago
                                                                     O2021-3078
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 7/21/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Gardiner (45)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-H at 4050 N Laporte Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BYTHE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-H in
the area bound by:

      the alley next south of and parallel to West Belle Plaine Avenue; North Laporte Avenue;
      the alley next north of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; and the alley next west of
      and parallel to North Laporte Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          <fames M. Garciiner
                                                          Alderman, 45'" Ward




Common Address:
4050 N. Laporte Avenue
